apple-200672920-0836.text:
The Siri team is redefining how hundreds of millions of people access information across Apple devices, with privacy built in from the ground up. As part of the Agentic Search Evaluation team, you will help advance Apple Intelligence through personalized search, result ranking, and low-latency production services that power experiences across Siri, Spotlight, Safari, Messages, and more. Your team researches and builds deep search systems for Personal Question Answering, enabling Siri to answer questions about a user's emails, messages, events, files, and more, while keeping personal data private.
We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineering Manager with a passion for building scalable, high-quality solutions to evaluate personalized search applications. In this role, you will directly shape how Apple assesses and improves the quality of Agentic Search — driving solutions across search quality, data quality, and both offline and online metrics to enable iterative product improvements. You will lead a team focused on evaluating Agentic Search experiences that power personalized Siri AI and enable answers to users' personal questions, with privacy at the forefront. Your team designs and builds evaluation systems, develops data generation and curation methods, and creates metrics frameworks for quality assessment and continuous improvement.
Lead a team of applied machine learning and software engineers to design and build scalable, automated systems for end-to-end evaluation of personalized Agentic Search
Contribute to the design and implementation of offline and online metrics to assess quality at the product and component level for Personal Question Answering, and drive iterative improvement
Collaborate with partner teams to define data and evaluation requirements, set priorities, and identify opportunities to enhance the Personal Question Answering stack
Define the long-term technical vision for personalized Siri Search quality, identify gaps, and drive solutions as part of a broader roadmap
Minimum Qualifications
6 or more years of industry experience building machine learning or machine learning evaluation systems at scale
2 or more years of industry experience in technical leadership or management
Knowledge of machine learning fundamentals, neural network architectures, and software engineering in Python or C/C++
Communication and collaboration skills
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field
Preferred Qualifications
Experience designing and building production machine learning systems in search, natural language processing, recommendation systems, or information retrieval
Experience in data collection, data generation, or data quality assessment of language, image, or multimodal data
Advanced degree (Master's or Ph.D.) in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience

The AirPods Firmware team is looking for an enthusiastic engineer to join our team. This is an individual contributor role to develop the technical development of the audio platform for our products. You will have the opportunity to drive the technology and product development for Apple's consumer audio products. In this role, you will work with a wide cross-functional team to continually innovate technology implemented in Apple products.
This is a high visibility role that involves architecting and developing our audio platform. This platform is a key technology that integrates and manages the data and system states for our products. We are seeking someone who is passionate about our products and the drive to improving the quality and innovation of our deliverables. The people here at Apple don’t just build products — they build the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. Excellent communication and collaboration is a must, as you will be asked to partner with team members and other engineering teams.
Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to define product features and requirements
Design, implement, debug, and test embedded C/C++ code running on 32-bit MCU's for Apple-branded audio products
Support debug of prototype hardware
Work with cross-functional team to define and meet timing, power and memory budgets
Minimum Qualifications
BS or M.S. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent, experience
5+ years of proven excellence in firmware, embedded software, or equivalent experience
Experience with MCUs, SW architecture, feature development, and memory & CPU constrained SW environments
Solid C/C++ coding abilities
Strong software debugging skills
Passion for product ownership and track record of product development
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Preferred Qualifications
Knowledge of real-time audio or Bluetooth technologies

Join Platform Apps & Technologies to lead the engineering teams responsible for defining and delivering the essential communication and productivity experiences that are at the heart of iOS. Drive the technical vision and execution for applications used by hundreds of millions of users daily, setting the standard for quality, performance, and role in defining the user experience around Messages, FaceTime, Mail, Contacts, and Phone.
This role requires collaboration across teams and close partnerships with Product Marketing, Human Interface, and Services to align on strategic directives.
Provide technical leadership and strategic direction for engineering teams building Messages, FaceTime, Mail, Contacts, and Phone, and drive architectural decisions that ensure seamless integration across Communication Apps at massive scale.
Partner with Human Interface, iOS Platform, and Services teams to deliver cohesive user experiences across Apple’s ecosystem and drive adoption of new iOS frameworks and capabilities, incorporating AI both in the product and the development process itself.
Champion privacy-first engineering practices, including end-to-end encryption implementations and engineering excellence standards for real-time communication, data synchronization, and offline capabilities
Lead cross-functional initiatives spanning CarPlay, Apple Watch, iPad, and Mac to ensure continuity features work flawlessly
Mentor senior engineers and engineering managers while building inclusive, high-performing teams, and collaborate with carrier partners and standards bodies on telephony and messaging innovations
Establish long-term technical direction by aligning engineering execution with product strategy and platform evolution

At least 2 years of experience at Director level or above.
Strong understanding of privacy, security, and encryption in communication applications, and excellence in system design for offline-first, sync-enabled, multi-device applications.
Passion for crafting intuitive, accessible, and delightful user experiences, with strong cross-functional collaboration skills that lead to the best outcomes for the customer.
Ability to influence and align stakeholders across hardware, software, and services organizations.
Track record of recruiting, mentoring, and developing world-class iOS engineers, including experience with career development and building inclusive teams.
Excellence in technical communication for audiences ranging from individual contributors to executive leadership.
Experience managing technical teams through ambiguity, organizational change, and evolving priorities.
Proven ability to translate leadership goals into actionable tasks, supported by experience in project planning and executive reporting.
Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor’s in Computer Science or equivalent work experience, with a proven track record shipping consumer-scale communication or productivity applications.

It’s the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you’ll do more than join something — you’ll add something.
Apple Vision Pro is a revolutionary spatial computer that seamlessly blends digital content with your physical space. It will allow us to do the things we love in ways never before possible — all while staying connected to the people around us.
The Vision Products Group (VPG) is looking for a Senior Graphics Software Engineer to help us push the limits of the next generation of interactive experiences on our platform. This team is working with some of Apple’s most advanced technologies including spatial computing, augmented reality, ARKit and Metal, to create ground-breaking new products. As a member of our creative organization, you will have the uniquely rewarding opportunity to craft future products that will delight and inspire millions of people every single day.
As a Senior Graphics Software Engineer, you’ll work with the newest technologies to bring Apple Vision Pro Environments to life. Environments give people an immersive space to work, watch, and play. People spend hours immersed under the auroras of Thórsmörk or sitting on the beach in Bora Bora, so every detail has to look convincingly real and every environment has to run efficiently to preserve battery life and keep the apps customers use running smoothly.
You’ll develop the system-level frameworks and real-time rendering techniques that make these places believable, from physically based materials to dynamic image-based lighting. You’ll write high-performance shaders, create RealityKit-based systems to drive effects, and profile each technique to analyze its GPU cost. You’ll use agentic workflows to iterate faster on development and optimization.
You’ll work closely with designers and technical artists across Apple and VPG, building the tools and pipelines that enable pre-visualization, optimization, and fine-tuning. You’ll partner with the teams that own the rendering engine and system-level frameworks to implement solutions and debug problems that cross the software stack. You work quickly and smartly to help determine the viability of new ideas and technologies. You bring a keen understanding of GPUs and lower-level programming. You have the ambition and curiosity to improve, innovate, and explore to bring surprise and delight to Apple customers.
Develop high-quality, real-time rendering techniques for immersive experiences
Partner with designers and technical artists to turn creative intent into production quality rendering features
Profile, analyze, and optimize rendering systems and 3D source content, focusing on power efficiency and performance, GPU and CPU utilization, memory footprint, and power consumption
Drive technical direction through R&D work, design documents, and code reviews
Build and extend artist tools for asset optimization and profiling
Mentor engineers and uphold high engineering standards across the team
Minimum Qualifications
7+ years of professional experience in real-time graphics or rendering engine development
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
Experience shipping high-quality GPU shaders and significant rendering features end to end
Proficiency in C++ and shader programming languages (Metal Shading Language, GLSL, or HLSL)
Proficient in mathematics for 3D real-time applications
Solid understanding of color science, human visual perception, texture sampling, compression, filtering, and of GPU memory management and frame pacing
Experience debugging complex rendering issues across multiple layers of the software stack
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to drive alignment across multiple partner teams
Preferred Qualifications
Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Graphics, or related field
Experience architecting and leading teams to build complex rendering systems
Understanding of Apple GPU architecture (tile-based deferred rendering)
Experience writing optimized code using profiling tools, assembly, SIMD, etc.
Experience reading and optimizing GPU intermediate representation formats
Experience using agentic iteration for rendering optimization

At Apple, individual creativity converges around shared values that drive innovation. Our CV/ML team works where perception, intelligence, and real-time processing meet. We have shipped Optic ID, Apple Vision Pro's biometric authentication, along with Eye Tracking and other computer vision features. We are looking for an experienced CV/ML engineer who runs rigorous experiments, shapes the data behind them, and brings modern deep learning architectures to products used by millions of people.
Ready to make an impact?
You will take on complex problems in understanding people from camera and sensor data, and you will own these problems from hypothesis to shipped model. You will shape experiments and what success looks like, and you will bring new methods where the established ones fall short. You know that model quality starts with the data: you find gaps and imbalances in it and work with partner teams to get the data that's missing. You will represent your area to hardware, software, and UX teams and adapt recent architectures for efficient on-device use.
Design, execute, and analyze ML experiments with sound baselines, metrics, and statistical rigor; help define evaluation/success criteria.
Assess datasets for coverage, quality, and bias; balance and curate them; define and drive data collection and annotation requests with partner teams.
Prototype and adapt modern ML network architectures.
Design model training optimized for real-world problems; train the models to meet state-of-the-art performance.
Build evaluation and failure analysis that reflect real-world use, including robustness and fairness across users and conditions.
Optimize models for on-device compute, memory, and latency budgets.
Represent the team cross-functionally and clearly communicate progress, impact, and trade-offs.
Mentor engineers within the team.
Minimum Qualifications
B.S. and minimum 10 years of industry experience in Machine Learning, Computer Vision or related field.
Hands-on experience training and evaluating deep learning models for vision.
Proficiency in Python and PyTorch.
Track record of designing experiments and drawing sound conclusions.
Preferred Qualifications
M.S. or Ph.D. in Machine Learning, Computer Vision or related field.
Experience in face or eye analysis or biometrics: detection, landmarks, tracking, gaze estimation, or recognition.
Experience curating large datasets and specifying data collection, including synthetic data.
Strong foundations in linear algebra, probability, and optimization.
Familiarity with optimizing models for deployment.
Experience shipping ML in consumer products, publishing at top-tier CV/ML conferences, or holding patents.
Expertise across multiple technical areas, solving cross-disciplinary challenges, and explaining the end-to-end system.
Track record of independently driving significant, ambiguous problems to resolution, with cross-functional impact, and setting technical direction with management and beyond.
Experience mentoring beyond your own team and communicating with senior leadership.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, and a curiosity for hard problems.

Apple’s Security Engineering & Architecture (SEAR) team builds the core operating system security that underpins every Apple product, including Mac, iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and more.
To keep our users safe, we’re looking for an exceptional senior threat intelligence analyst to join our group of security researchers and threat intelligence analysts. This team works together and cross-functionally to drive efforts to solve security engineering challenges. Our focus is on guiding decisions that deliver the strongest security over the long term. The success we achieve is the result of very skilled people working in an environment that cultivates creativity, partnership, and solving old problems in new ways.
Protecting more than a billion devices. Turning security research and threat intelligence into engineering decisions that shape every layer of the stack. Making a difference for everyone who uses our products. Working at a company where user privacy is central to everything it does. Collaborating with some of the most creative, dedicated, and driven engineers in the industry. Being pushed every day to think beyond the conventional and find new ways to make software safer, simpler, and more enjoyable to use. All of this comes together in one place: Apple
You will have a broad set of skills that make you successful as threats continue to evolve, capable of analyzing cyber threats to our users’ devices. Our environment fosters innovation, rapid solution development, and a liberating amount of autonomy. You will be expected to work with security engineers and researchers in order to quickly bring to market new security methods and technologies addressing the complex needs of mobile and distributed computing.
Provide input into development of security technologies.
Analyze and understand advanced cyber actors, capabilities, and techniques.
Analyze and understand exploit development and proliferation.
Collaborate with security researchers to drive engineering solutions.
Work with security engineers in designing innovative mitigations to cyber threats while preserving privacy, ease-of-use, and user experience.
Work closely with external partners in support of cyber threat intelligence activities.
Remote work, with occasional travel.
Minimum Qualifications
Intellectually curious team player with a genuine passion for discovering, understanding, and mitigating cyber threats.Deep knowledge of the threat intelligence lifecycle and cyber operations.
Minimum of 5 years of hands-on threat research experience, ideally including time as a technical lead.
Experience in analyzing highly-complex threat actor campaigns, including infrastructure, malware, and victim endpoints.
Experience working on wireless stack technologies.
Some knowledge of iOS internals.
Impeccable attention to detail.
Preferred Qualifications
Ability to distill complex problems into manageable tasks and then drive those tasks to completion.
Growth mindset, thrives in fast-paced, changing environments.
Excellent communications skills (verbal and written).
Proven history of successfully working on solo and group projects (experience with virtual/remote collaboration is required).

apple-200696349-0157.text:
Join Apple’s Hardware group and help develop innovative solutions that drive the seamless integration of hardware and software. In this role, you will contribute to building the technology that powers Apple’s products—ensuring they deliver the performance, reliability, and user experience loved by millions around the world. You’ll work at the intersection of hardware and software, solving complex challenges in a highly collaborative and uniquely Apple environment.
In this role, you will develop the tools and flows for managing a single, authoritative description of the hardware/software interface. This includes capturing new architectural requirements from Apple's hardware designs in the common description format and its compiler, ensuring every generated output reflects them correctly, and keeping hardware interface data flowing continuously to software teams for all Apple hardware projects.
This visible and cross-functional role also covers services that make this data accessible across the organization: tracking, searching, browsing, and comparing interface descriptions across projects and releases. The work is full-stack, from low-level C++ development to hosted web services and client user interfaces. It's a close partnership with the designers and software engineers who rely on these tools every day.
Collaborating with internal hardware design teams and the broader software organization to enable co-development and integration.
Defining and evolving an IP-XACT-compatible register description format.
Designing, developing, and maintaining robust, scalable, and intelligent HW/SW interface tools and infrastructure.
Automating data exchange pipelines to enhance collaboration within Apple and with external vendors.
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field
Experience in C++ and Python programming
Experience with git, perforce, or other version control systems
Preferred Qualifications
3+ years of relevant industry experience
Knowledge of hardware development fundamentals and chip design concepts
Experience with IP-XACT, SystemRDL, or other hardware register description standards
Comfortable developing in macOS and Linux environments
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated build systems (GitLab CI, TeamCity, etc.)
Proven ability to work collaboratively across hardware and software teams
Strong communication skills and ability to articulate technical and architectural concepts
Understanding of RTL development and design verification methodologies

Embedded within Apple’s Security Engineering & Architecture organization, our team’s mission is to ensures secure runtime environments for our firmware, constrained, and isolated compute environments, so that we can protect sensitive user assets and prevent advanced attacks against our customers. We're looking for an outstanding Firmware Security Researcher to join our exceptional team whose focus is on securing the lowest level of our system to create secure and privacy preserving products that billions of users trust.
As a Firmware Security Researcher, you will work with cutting edge technology alongside some of the most creative, passionate, hardworking engineers in the industry; collaborating with teams from software, hardware, user privacy, design, and more. Your influence will be felt throughout Apple's extraordinary products, including: the iPhone, Apple Vision Pro, Mac and Apple TV. Our team challenge and learn from each other to go beyond the norm to find new, innovative ways of solving problems and making our software, hardware, and customers safer. A typical day in the role may include:
* Evaluating security-critical aspects of our products, from system architecture to code review, from product features definition to circuit layout
* Providing security focused consultations to partner teams on new features and technologies
* Developing intelligent automated tools for security analysis, verification, and regression defence
* Identifying threats and driving the development of mitigations to prevent them
* Challenging existing mitigation techniques through evaluation and proof of concept exploitation * reverse engineering exploits, if necessary
This position may require some travel to other Apple sites and vendors.
Minimum Qualifications
Familiarity with firmware and embedded system technologies
Experience with secure programming and code auditing
Knowledge of modern anti-exploitation mitigations and their effectiveness
Background in firmware or systems programming, ideally in C, C++, or another systems programming language
Excellent communication skills
Preferred Qualifications
Ideas and enthusiasm for using AI to fundamentally change the field of security engineering
Proficiency with threat modelling complex systems
Background in software exploitation
Familiarity with operating system internals, especially macOS, iOS, or other flavours of UNIX
Experience with memory safe programming languages and/or techniques

We truly believe it can! We are looking for highly skilled senior software engineers experienced in architecting and deploying test and validation infrastructure for consumer-facing products using large-scale client/server ML systems.
You will play a critical role in designing and building LLMs online and offline validation infrastructure, tools, frameworks, and methodologies that enable product teams across Apple to develop state-of-the-art generative AI solutions that power amazingly intelligent user experiences on iPhone, Mac, Watch, iPad, and more. We are the Intelligence System Experience (ISE) team within Apple’s software organization. The team works at the intersection between multimodal machine learning and system experiences. System Experience (Springboard, Settings), Keyboards, Pencil & Paper, Shortcuts are some of the experiences that the team oversees. These experiences that our users enjoy are backed by production scale ML workflows. Visual Understanding of People, Text, Handwriting & Scenes, multilingual NLP for writing workflows & knowledge extraction, behavioral modeling for proactive suggestions, and privacy preserving learning are areas our multi disciplinary ML teams focus on.
This role is responsible for defining and developing generative AI systems validation infrastructure by collaborating with diverse cross-functional partners, including machine learning engineers, data scientists, software developers, and product managers. The evaluation infrastructure includes adopting or building new client and server CI pipelines and developing scalable automation tools and frameworks across all Apple platforms. The evaluation infrastructure should allow cross-functional teams to conduct rigorous testing to ensure the accuracy, performance, reliability, and stability of ISE’s future generative AI models across various products and use cases. This role will also work closely with product and program teams to ensure validation infrastructure development is done in lockstep with the new features and products roadmap and to drive a high adoption among product and ML engineers. This is a fast-paced role with high visibility, impact, and influence in building one of the industry’s most advanced generative AI systems.
Minimum Qualifications
BS/MS in Computer Science, Machine Learning or related field
6+ years of proven expertise in software development with Java, Python, Swift, or Objective-C
Preferred Qualifications
Strong software engineering skills to create a scalable and robust infrastructure for generative AI systems training and inference pipelines leveraging on-device and server-side ML models.
Fundamental knowledge of ML concepts and understanding of ML-based product lifecycle and operations
Familiarity with ML toolkits such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, SkLearn, etc.
Hands-on experience in building an automation infrastructure, tools, and frameworks for large-scale AI/ML or cloud- based applications leveraging cross-functional partnerships

We are a team of computer vision and machine learning (CVML) engineers building real-time 3D perception and input systems for future Apple products. We are looking for a strong CVML engineer with both 3D geometry and ML background, optimally with experience in 3D rigid/non-rigid object tracking, sensor fusion, or SLAM/VIO. In this role, you will help design, build, and ship core 3D perception and input technologies used by millions of users.
You will work closely with CVML researchers and engineers to develop world-class perception, spatial input, and 3D tracking algorithms and software. The role focuses on inventing and implementing state of the art CVML algorithms to solve cutting edge problems. As a member of a fast-paced team, you have the unique and rewarding opportunity to shape upcoming products that will delight and inspire millions of people every day.
Invent and implement state-of-the-art CV/ML algorithms for perception and 3D tracking
Design robust, efficient solutions optimized for mobile and on-device hardware
Collaborate across software, hardware, and systems teams to ensure efficient end-to-end pipelines and effective use of Apple silicon
Iterate quickly based on data, feedback, and system constraints
Contribute to technical direction and roadmaps for next-generation perception and AI capabilities
Translate research ideas into production-quality systems and integrations
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree with 5+ years of relevant industry experience
Strong foundation in computer vision in one or multiple of these areas, including 3D rigid/non-rigid object tracking, multi-view geometry, and visual-inertial odometry (VIO)
Proficiency in Python and deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch
Preferred Qualifications
PhD in computer vision, machine learning, robotics, or related fields
Experience across both classical 3D computer vision and deep learning
Familiarity with visual-inertial or multi-sensor fusion
Strong C++ and systems engineering skills, with experience delivering robust, efficient algorithms
Self-motivated with a proven record of prioritization and on-time delivery
